Gina (Finance): Heads-up: launching a small billing tweak Monday — brief bursts now get a short grace before hard throttles and invoices will show a new 'grace_used_tokens' line.

Marco (Product): Nice. Does this change client-visible 429 behavior?

Gina (Finance): For spikes <=30s expect fewer immediate 429s. Sustained overage still throttled. We'll publish a KB with examples and opt-out steps.

Claire (Support): Need the customer blurb and sample email.

Gina (Finance): Draft: 'Short bursts may be absorbed by a grace window; persistent traffic is billed as before. See Usage adjustments -> grace_used_tokens on your invoice.'

ops-bot: Canary scheduled Tue 03:30 UTC to 10% traffic, auto-rollback on error-rate +0.5% or latency regressions.

Claire (Support): I'll prep KB + canned replies. Ping when API schema ships.

Gina (Finance): Billing API v1.3 will include the new field — warn integrators to relax strict schema checks. Thanks team.
